title: Pay every repeated local firing from the actual state reached
statement: For S within fixed L1 radiusr ofx,m<=(2r+1)^d. Under delta<=1/2 each enabled labelled firing has probability>=p_x=kappa_min/[4J(1+N+r)^D]. From ANY actual state inS,an exterior route uses at mostm changing transitions,so chance of exit within the nextm actual firings is>=p_x^m. Restarting at the actual state after failure gives Pr(F_S>km)<=(1-p_x^m)^k,E F_S<=m p_x^-m andE tau_S<=2m p_x^-m/kappa_min. Every fixed cost moment is polynomial in1+N andkappa_min^-1. All zero-change and failed internal events are counted; no population reset,free holding clock or successful-word-only cost is used. Finite sets without the exit hypothesis are outside this theorem.

Exact local rational systems have fixed size; numerator degree<=mD+1 and population-dependent bit arithmetic is polynomial. Conditional compiler bit work/memory/output are polynomial in complete binary input length; T,delta^-1,inverse nominal rates and expected ALL actual firings are polynomial in W=2+|x0|1+sum(lambda_i+lambda_i^-1)+epsilon^-1. Proof-only reset/memory variables change no physical rate or population. No trajectory,stationary-law or coefficient oracle is supplied or run by Capital.
